# Purpose

Award credit for a correct torque load path, consistent power and speed units, the solid-shaft torsion relation, upward standard-size selection, stress verification, and a bounded engineering recommendation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes steady pure torsion of a uniform solid circular shaft. Belt-induced bending, transverse bearing reactions, keyways, stress concentrations, fatigue, shock loading, critical speed, coupling details, and bearing selection require additional models and data.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- power, speed, and torque conversion: 20%;
- theoretical diameter and standard selection: 30%;
- stress and twist verification: 20%;
- engineering recommendation and limitations: 10%.
